sections.Profile:
The "Olympics" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in May 1952, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features two impulse flippers, four pop bumpers, and four trap holes.

- Years made: 1952
